subtitle: Private Itinerary • 21 Days Thailand Grand Expedition
description: A 21-day trip through Thailand: Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai, and Pattaya (28 Oct - 17 Nov 2026). Experience the energy of the capital, explore the Andaman Sea, enjoy the nature and Lanna culture of the north, and unwind by the sea in Pattaya before flying back to the USA.
